_readme: RunHub source list. Add or remove portals here; no code change needed for 'jsonld' sources.
enabled:false skips a source. 'type' picks the scraper (defaults to the key name).
Built-in types: racexasia, jomrun, howei, biib, heyjom, ticket2u, lesgo.
Generic type 'jsonld': give baseUrl + listUrls (pages that link to events) + linkPattern (regex
matched against hrefs). Each event page is read for schema.org Event JSON-LD.

politeness._note: Applied to every outbound request. A site's own Crawl-delay always wins, up to maxCrawlDelayMs.

checkpointspot.note: Cloudflare 403. Needs Playwright + credentials. Covered indirectly through lesgo.

jomlari2u.note: Detail pages return HTTP 500 (event.categories.map). Re-enable when fixed.

racingschedule.note: AI crawler (BitNet on this host). Prose pages with no structured data. ~6s/page.

emas.note: Kept as a template only. robots.txt allows crawling but declares Content-Signal ai-train=no and blocks AI-training bots, so the AI crawler refuses it (see scrapers/robots.mjs aiUseAllowed).
